assertions.assertion: Recommends setting options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false in test configuration
Recommends AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false) to avoid disk writes
assertions.rationale: Shows AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false) and warns about default persistence writing tempkey.jwk.

assertions.assertion: Warns against hard-coding localhost ports — use factory.CreateClient() BaseAddress instead
assertions.rationale: Port-conflict section says TestServer needs no port, use factory.CreateClient() and remove UseUrls hard-coded localhost:5001.

assertions.assertion: Mentions the risk of sharing HttpClient or ClaimsProvider state across parallel tests
assertions.rationale: Shared-state section only says not to share mutable test data and to use IClassFixture; it never mentions sharing HttpClient or ClaimsProvider state across parallel tests.
